schema.label: Armor class
schema.formula: (armor_choiceNone * (10 + abilities_dexterity_mod) + armor_choiceLight * (armor_base + abilities_dexterity_mod) + armor_choiceMedium * (armor_base + min(abilities_dexterity_mod, 2)) + armor_choiceHeavy * armor_base + armor_choiceBarbarian * (10 + abilities_dexterity_mod + abilities_constitution_mod) + armor_choiceMonk * (10 + abilities_dexterity_mod + abilities_wisdom_mod * (1 - armor_shield))) + armor_shield * 2 + armor_misc

schema.label: Spellcasting ability modifier
schema.formula: abilities_strength_mod * spellcasting_abilityStrength + abilities_dexterity_mod * spellcasting_abilityDexterity + abilities_constitution_mod * spellcasting_abilityConstitution + abilities_intelligence_mod * spellcasting_abilityIntelligence + abilities_wisdom_mod * spellcasting_abilityWisdom + abilities_charisma_mod * spellcasting_abilityCharisma

schema.label: Hit point maximum
schema.formula: max(1, combat_hp_base + abilities_constitution_mod * identity_level + combat_hp_perLevel * (identity_level - 1) + combat_hp_misc)

schema.label: Blinded: can't see and automatically fails ability checks that require sight
Charmed: can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities or magical effects
Deafened: can't hear and automatically fails ability checks that require hearing
Frightened: has Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the source of fear is in sight
Grappled: Speed is 0 and can't benefit from bonuses to Speed
Incapacitated: can't take actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions
Invisible: attacks against the creature have Disadvantage, and its attacks have Advantage
Paralyzed: Incapacitated and can't move or speak; attacks against the creature have Advantage
Petrified: transformed into a solid substance, Incapacitated and unaware of its surroundings
Poisoned: has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks
Prone: can only crawl or stand up; attacks have Disadvantage unless the attacker is within 5 feet
Restrained: Speed is 0, attacks against it have Advantage, and its attacks have Disadvantage
Stunned: Incapacitated, can't move and speaks only falteringly
Unconscious: Incapacitated and unaware of its surroundings; attacks against it have Advantage

deathSaves.label: Death saves (10 or higher succeeds; a natural 1 is two failures; a natural 20 regains 1 hit point and resets both)

schema.label: Damage bonus
schema.formula: record_abilityStrength * abilities_strength_mod + record_abilityDexterity * abilities_dexterity_mod + record_abilityConstitution * abilities_constitution_mod + record_abilityIntelligence * abilities_intelligence_mod + record_abilityWisdom * abilities_wisdom_mod + record_abilityCharisma * abilities_charisma_mod

schema.label: To hit
schema.formula: record_abilityStrength * abilities_strength_mod + record_abilityDexterity * abilities_dexterity_mod + record_abilityConstitution * abilities_constitution_mod + record_abilityIntelligence * abilities_intelligence_mod + record_abilityWisdom * abilities_wisdom_mod + record_abilityCharisma * abilities_charisma_mod + record_proficient * identity_proficiencyBonus + record_misc
